HelpBody:
Hover over a folder name in the address bar to highlight it, then click to navigate. For long paths, use the left … menu to choose a folder. Click empty space to edit the path; Esc cancels editing.

Ctrl + L / Alt + D: Edit the path, then Enter to navigate
Ctrl + Shift + C: Copy the current folder path
Alt + ← / → / ↑: Go back, forward, or up
Ctrl + F: Search this folder
F5: Refresh
Ctrl + Shift + N: Create a new folder
Ctrl + C / X / V: Copy, cut, or paste
F2 / Delete: Rename or move to the Recycle Bin

Supports local paths, network shares (UNC), and environment variables such as %USERPROFILE%.
Paste a file path to open its folder and select the file. Search includes files and folders in all subfolders.
Existing items are never overwritten. Copying or moving symbolic links and junctions is not supported.

Search this folder and subfolders by name · /file files only · /dir folders only

HelpOverview:
Click a folder name in the address bar to navigate. Click empty space to edit the path; Esc cancels editing.
Supports local paths, network shares (UNC), and environment variables such as %USERPROFILE%. Paste a file path to open its folder and select the file.
Search includes files and folders in all subfolders. Use /file for files or /dir for folders. Existing items are never overwritten. Copying or moving symbolic links and junctions is not supported.
Change keyboard shortcuts in preferences. Enter confirms path editing and dialogs; Esc cancels.
